summary: Plan-then-assumptions RAG: draft plan, surface unknowns, phrase questions
hypothesis: Having the model draft a concrete plan first should force it to commit to real decision-critical assumptions (budget, departure city, scale), which can then be turned into better-targeted questions than abstract brainstorming produces.
technique: A two-FM-call pipeline: the first call has the stock 3B draft a concrete plan and explicitly surface the assumptions it was forced to make; the second call feeds those surfaced assumptions into the exp003 RAG few-shot scaffold to phrase and atomise them into 7 questions.

stages.text: Fetch RAG few-shot exemplars for phrasing
Draft concrete plan, surface forced assumptions
